items.title: Formally verifying agent-written full-stack web apps with PDD Kit
items.description: AI agents can generate code at a scale that’s hard for humans to review line-by-line. It converts developer intent into a Verus specification, proves AI-generated code meets it for every input, and uses tests where proofs aren't practical. Developers review intent, not every line. items.title: Community detection in complex networks via node similarity, graph representation learning, and hierarchical clustering
items.description: arXiv:2303.12212v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Community detection is a significant challenge in analysing real graphs, including social, citation, biological, and many other networks. This article proposes three new, general, hierarchical frameworks to deal with this task. The introduced approach supports various linkage-based clustering algorithms, vertex proximity matrices, and graph representation learning models. We compare 364 module combinations on Stochastic Block Model graphs and real-life datasets. We observe that our best pipelines (Wasserman-Faust and the mutual information-based PPMI proximity, as well as the deep learning-based DNGR representations) perform competitively with the state-of-the-art Leiden and Louvain algorithms.
